rationale: wezterm-font can live in wezterm-gpui only if that graph has a single `links = "freetype"` crate. GPUI's font-kit already uses freetype-sys 0.20.1. wezterm-gui keeps vendored deps/freetype. Isolated workspaces stay; the GPUI workspace compiles wezterm-font with feature sys-freetype (bindgen via gpui-freetype, no freetype-sys dep on that shim so the root lockfile does not gain a second links crate).
